query: INSERT INTO twitch_chatter_rollup (streamer_login, chatter_login, chatter_id, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, total_messages, total_sessions) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $4, 0, 1) ON CONFLICT (streamer_login, chatter_login) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at, chatter_id = COALESCE(twitch_chatter_rollup.chatter_id, EXCLUDED.chatter_id)
